client_context.text: Trevos is a pizzería that currently operates in two locations in Cancún, one at Supermanzada 316 and the other at Bofi.
client_context.quote: Trevos is a pizzería that currently operates in two locations in Cancún, one at Supermanzada 316 and the other at Bofi.

problem.text: The problem with Trevos is that they manage their business through Facebook, which has some limitations.
problem.quote: The problem with Trevos is that they manage their business through Facebook, which has some limitations.

goals.text: Trevos wants to implement an online system to better manage their business.
goals.quote: Trevos wants to implement an online system to better manage their business.

requirements.text: The system should have a more elegant menu for users, a section to view different types of menus, the ability to make reservations without messaging on Facebook, a gallery to show installations and pizza preparation, and an automatic billing system.
requirements.quote: The system should have a more elegant menu for users, a section to view different types of menus, the ability to make reservations without messaging on Facebook, a gallery to show installations and pizza preparation, and an automatic billing system.

constraints.text: Trevos does not need a section to edit clients or their registration system at this time.

proposal.summary: Propuesta para implementar un sistema en línea para Trevos
proposal.problem_understanding: Trevos necesita un sistema en línea para mejorar la gestión de su negocio, ya que actualmente utilizan Facebook que tiene algunas limitaciones.

scope.text: Desarrollar un sistema en línea para Trevos

deliverables.text: Crear un menú más elegante para los usuarios
Incluir una sección para ver diferentes tipos de menú
Permitir reservaciones sin enviar mensajes en Facebook
Crear una galería para mostrar instalaciones y preparación de pizza
Incluir un sistema de facturación automático

out_of_scope.text: No se requiere una sección para editar clientes o su sistema de registro en este momento

proposal.timeline: Pendiente definir el cronograma del proyecto
